chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Muqatil ibn Sulayman from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: "I am the master of the prophets, and my successor is the master of the successors, and his successors are the masters of the successors.
Indeed, Adam عليه السلام asked Allah, Mighty and Majestic, to appoint for him a righteous successor, so Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to him.
"Indeed I have honored the prophets with prophethood, then I selected from My creation a creation, and I made the best of them the successors."

So Allah, Exalted is His remembrance, revealed to him: "O Adam, appoint Seth as your successor." Then Adam عليه السلام appointed Seth, and he was Hibat Allah, son of Adam. Seth appointed his son Shabban, and he was the son of Nazlah al-Hawra', whom Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent down upon Adam from Paradise, and he married her to his son Seth. Shabban appointed Mahlath, and Mahlath appointed Mahuq, and Mahuq appointed Ghathmisha, and Ghathmisha appointed Akhnukh, and he was Idris the Prophet عليه السلام. Idris appointed Nahur, and Nahur passed it to Nuh عليه السلام. Nuh appointed Sam, and Sam appointed Athamir, and Athamir appointed Barghithasha, and Barghithasha appointed Yafith, and Yafith appointed Barrah, and Barrah appointed Jafsiyyah, and Jafsiyyah appointed Imran, and Imran passed it to Ibrahim al-Khalil عليه السلام. Ibrahim appointed his son Ismail, and Ismail appointed Ishaq, and Ishaq appointed Yaqub, and Yaqub appointed Yusuf, and Yusuf appointed Bathriya', and Bathriya' appointed Shu'ayb, and Shu'ayb passed it to Musa ibn Imran عليه السلام. Musa ibn Imran appointed Yusha' ibn Nun, and Yusha' ibn Nun appointed Dawud, and Dawud appointed Sulayman عليه السلام. Sulayman appointed Asif ibn Barkhiya, and Asif ibn Barkhiya appointed Zakariyya, and Zakariyya passed it to Isa ibn Maryam عليه السلام. Isa ibn Maryam appointed Sham'un ibn Hammun al-Safa, and Sham'un appointed Yahya ibn Zakariyya, and Yahya ibn Zakariyya appointed Mundhir, and Mundhir appointed Sulaymah, and Sulaymah appointed Burdah."

"Then the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: Burdah passed it to me, and I pass it to you, O Ali. And you will pass it to your successor, and your successor will pass it to your successors from your offspring, one after another, until it is passed to the best of the people of the earth after you. And the Ummah will surely disbelieve in you, and they will surely differ concerning you with severe disagreement. The one steadfast upon you is like the one residing with me, and the one who deviates from you is in the Fire, and the Fire is the abode of the disbelievers."

key_terms.النَّارُ: the Fire, meaning hellfire in this context
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءَ: the divinely appointed trustees or successors
key_terms.الْوَصِيِّينَ: the successors entrusted after the prophets

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the chain of divinely appointed successors from Adam عليه السلام to Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a continuous line of divinely chosen awsiya' from Adam عليه السلام through the prophets until the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, who then entrusts the succession to Imam Ali عليه السلام and thereafter to his descendants. It emphasizes the theological principle of designated succession and portrays steadfastness to Imam Ali عليه السلام as the mark of fidelity, while opposition to him is linked with deviation and punishment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5402 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Muqatil ibn Sulayman from Abu Abdullah (as) who said that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"I am the master of the prophets, and my successor is the master of the successors, and his successors are the masters of the successors.
Indeed, Adam (as) asked Allah (swt), the Glorious and Exalted, to appoint for him a righteous successor.

Allah (swt), the Glorious and Exalted, revealed to him:
'I have honored the prophets with prophethood, and then I selected from My creation individuals and made the best among them the successors.'

So Allah (swt), Exalted is His (swt) remembrance, revealed to him: 'O' Adam, appoint Seth as your successor.'
Thus, Adam (as) appointed Seth, who is the Gift of Allah (swt), son of Adam, as his successor. Seth then appointed his son Shabban as his successor, and Shabban was the son of Nazla Al-Hawra, whom Allah (swt), the Glorious and Exalted, sent down to Adam from Paradise, and Adam married her to his son Seth.
Shabban appointed Muhlith as his successor, Muhlith appointed Mahuq, Mahuq appointed Ghathmisha, Ghathmisha appointed Akhnukh, who is Prophet Idris (as).
Idris appointed Nahur, and Nahur passed it on to Nuh (as). Nuh appointed his son Sam, Sam appointed Athamir, and Athamir appointed Barghithasha.
And Barghithasha appointed Yafith as his successor, Yafith appointed Barra, Barra appointed Jafsiya, Jafsiya appointed Imran, and Imran entrusted it to Ibrahim Al-Khalil (as). Ibrahim appointed his son Ismail, Ismail appointed Ishaq, Ishaq appointed Yaqub, Yaqub appointed Yusuf, Yusuf appointed Bathriya, Bathriya appointed Shuayb, and Shuayb entrusted it to Musa ibn Imran (as). Musa ibn Imran appointed Yusha ibn Nun, Yusha ibn Nun appointed Dawud, Dawud appointed Sulayman (as), Sulayman appointed Asif ibn Barkhiya, Asif ibn Barkhiya appointed Zakariya, and Zakariya entrusted it to Isa ibn Maryam (as). Isa ibn Maryam appointed Shamun ibn Hamun Al-Safa, Shamun appointed Yahya ibn Zakariya, Yahya ibn Zakariya appointed Mundhir, Mundhir appointed Sulaymah, and Sulaymah appointed Burdah."

Then the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Burdah entrusted it to me, and I now entrust it to you, O' Ali (as).
You (as) will entrust it to your successor (as), and your successor (as) will entrust it to his successors (as) from your offspring, one after another, until it reaches the best of the people of the earth after you.
Surely, the nation will disbelieve in you, and they will differ greatly over you. The one who remains steadfast with you (as) is like the one who remains with me (sw), and the one who separates from you (as) will be in the Fire, and the Fire is the abode of the disbelievers."
